mythology: Sati's anklet (Nupura / Gulpha) fell on the promontory of Lanka; here Ravana sang the Shiva Tandava Stotram to appease the Lord after attempting to lift Mount Kailash.
pilgrimage_significance: First listed Shakti Peetha in Adi Shankaracharya's Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha Stotram ('Lankayam Shankari Devi'); ancient southern anchor of the sacred geography of Bharatavarsha.
historical_notes: Mentioned in the Ramayana, Mahabharata, and hymns of Sambandar and Sundarar (Tevaram); acclaimed as Dakshina Kailasam.
